notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
Outside of bug fixing, the main things we wanted to tackle with this patch were

 1. Improving the in-game store 

and

2. Giving players a way to get costume items that were no longer available. These ended up dovetailing very nicely and I think we've managed to tick both boxes.

-----------------------------------------

[b] Improved Store[/b]

These are the main changes
1. We've drastically improved the store UI so that now you can, among other things, see more than 1 item at a time.
2. We've gotten rid of the old green PD icon and we've replaced it with a shiny Golden Karat! ⭐️
3. We've added a second currency that players will be able to use for some items in the store without spending money called...Silver Karats (ok we ran out of ideas). More on this in a sec. 
4. We've added _lots_ of items from previous Twitch streams, giveaways etc. This is something we heard a lot about as players would see costumes they liked but couldn't get their hands on. 


“Ok but how to we get Silver Karats!?” I hear you say. 
Now this part is interesting. Introducing.....

[b]Trust No Bunny Discord Bot[/b]

Ok so we might have had a bit too much fun with this one but the bot basically works like this, there's even some lore...There's this shady Count and he shows up in Discord servers every so often. When you spot him you can have a go at maybe liberating him of some of his ill-gotten Silver Karats. Just /roll, the higher you roll the more Silver you'll escape with - just hope you don't roll a 1, I've heard bad things happen.

Note: You'll have to link your Discord x TNB accounts for this to work (you can do so in-game).
The bot will be in our official Discord server but other servers are welcome to add it to theirs as well. the more servers you have it in the more Silver you can pilfer.

We'll also be looking to add Silver Karats as an in-game earnable currency (e.g. after winning a game), although that will take a bit of time to make sure we get it right and it doesn't impact games in any sort of negative way :eyes: 


[b]September Twitch Drop[/b]

Just in case you missed it we'll be dropping the Sus Samurai starting from the 4/5th (depending on your time zone)  till the end of the month.
Drops happen here! -> https://www.twitch.tv/ratmantnb


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

 - Fixed a bug that was causing the Carpenter Steam achievement from not properly being granted

 - Fixed a bug that was causing Dizzying Stench wins not to count toward the relevant win stat 

 - Fixed some issues related to text formatting

 - Fixed a number of under-the-hood bugs that might have caused issues related to selecting cosmetics (we’re keeping an eye on this one, let us know if you run into issues with selecting cosmetics)



[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

- We've made some balance changes to the incoming wolf numbers for 5 and 8 player games. Those are currently too tough for Townsfolk at 5 and Werebunnies at 8. We'll be keeping an eye on win rates this month to see if they turn back in the right direction.

- Japanese has been added we're fixing formatting issues as we find them ( the font implementation is a challenge^^). Its been very cool seeing a small but _very_ active Japanese community shoot up so quickly - ありがとうございます！

notes.title: New Quirk: Naive!
notes.content:

- Bless -> Gift
- Players can now join a lobby while a game is going on. They will automatically be carried into the next game.
- Fixed a number of bugs

notes.title: New Quirk - NAIVE!
notes.content:
Features: 
- Bless has been changed to Gift. Players give cards to each other rather than the recipient simply receiving an extra card. 
- The number of wolves has been brought down by 1 each night as a balance measure
- The Quirk Naive has been added to the game: Must gift twice to win the game 
- Stubborn has been nerfed and now requires 3 'No' votes to be satisfied 
- Players can now join lobbies that have games in progress. They will sit in the lobby until the game finishes, and will be loaded into the subsequent game 

Bugfixes: 
- Fixed a bug where the mic toggle would indicate that it's off, even when it's on. 
- Fixed a bug where a Bless would no go through if the player had Holy Candle and they were sabotaged that night. Bless has been changed to gift, but a gift with a Holy Candle will now turn into an ordinary Gift if sabotaged that night
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause all players to be wearing the same outfit 
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Accuse to not work for certain players
- Fixed a bug that caused a players chat to break upon reconnecting

notes.title: Steam Mystery Event Patch
notes.content:
Feb 2023 Patch Notes


This week kicks off the Steam Mystery Fest  - An event dedicated to games involving deduction and I presume rabbit intrigue. 

Event Notes

The Vault: Each player will have a vault with a special Pinstripe edition of the Detective Suit, 100 PD, and an all new event emote chosen at random.

“How do I crack the vault?!” I hear you say. 
Easy, insert the correct 4 alphanumeric code and you’re in!

“Where do I get the alphanumeric code!?” I hear you say. 
Well this you’ll have to work for. Each time you win a game you’ll be given one part of your code. Win 4 games and you’ll have all the information you need to crack the code. 

“So I just input the letters and numbers and I’m in!?” 
Ah sweet summer child... You’ll have to input them in the correct order. You didn’t think it would be easy to break into a vault did you? 

New Detective Themed Emotes in the store

We’ll be 20% for the duration of the event so It’s a great time to pressure your friends who haven’t played yet
Pinstripe Detective Hat Twitch Drop - Available as a drop to anyone streaming Trust No Bunny

	Note: Your account will need to be connected to a verified email address in order to unlock the vault. Check your inbox or request another confirmation email from the settings menu if you haven’t gotten one yet. 

New Features 

New Stats Screen: Ever wonder which item gets you the most wins? Or if you really DO never win as Werebunny? The all new Stats Screen will show you which Mutations, Quirks, and Items you’re winning with. We’ll be starting everyone out from 0 wins when the patch goes live - This will not affect your regular account level. 

New Renown System: Going hand in hand with new Stats is the Renown system. In a nutshell you unlock medals as you win games. Renown levels will be visible to other players in the lobby. You’ll earn Renown Points for winning games in each of the new Stats categories - Winning games as Townsfolk or with Patchy’s Tools for example. Starting from a lowly wooden token you’ll progress through the ranks, unlocking Bronze, Gold, and Ruby Medals  among others. Can you make the Illustrious Pinnacle Medal yours? 


Bug Fixes

- Fixed Email verification process and found some bugs while we were at it

notes.title: Small February Patch
notes.content:
Small gameplay updates: 
* Snap Trap 2000 now triggers on any sabotage attempt and cannot be destroy (we realize that this makes sabotage even weaker, and we'll be looking to buff it in a subsequent patch) 
* Accuse has been disabled for 5-player games because it provides too much information at lower player counts 

QoL Updates: 
* The hotkey 'V' toggles the mic volume of everyone else at once. Useful for streaming
* New accounts now have a pre-set emote loadout

Localization 
* Web build now available in Korean and Chinese 

Bug fixes: 
* Fixed a bug that caused one of the house to not be able to emote 
* Fixed a bug where a players 'mic off' icon wasn't appear while in tower
* Fixed a bug where players Pixie color highlight would change when other players changed their color
* Fixed a bug that was causing the final nomination warning to appear too man times 
* Card calculations now have a server-side check to prevent cheating 
* Fixed a bug that would cause things to occasionally break when one Werebunny blessed another Werebunny that had Hypnotic Eyes
